title: Ash Sabbath
description: Port of Ashes from The "15 Year Journey map"
body:
# Description
This texture pack brings the ash from the "**15 Years Journey map**" to Minecraft Java Edition. I have tried to recreate the ash as closely as possible to the original while ensuring it fits the Vanilla aesthetic

![Before/After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb9a4851f1f5595f0b7037a1a621cc17cf69e8f3.jpeg)

### How does it works
-The ash appears only on the top surfaces of basalt blocks

-The ash layer disappears if a block is placed directly on top of it


### How to install
1. Download "Ash Sabbath.zip" file

2. Open "resourcepack" folder

3. Drag and drop the file into that folder

If you like Actions & Stuff style, you can join my Discord server. You might find something interesting...
